name: Space Chimps
summary: Space Apes is an exhilarating VR fan game inspired by Gorilla Tag, launching players into the depths of space for fast-paced, movement-based gameplay! As a futuristic ape, you'll sprint, climb, and swing through massive sci-fi environments, from high-tech space stations to mysterious alien landscapes. But you're not alone—strange, lurking monsters prowl the shadows, adding an extra layer of danger to every match.
